TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Transaction to execute the creation of the massive pricing rules
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: ABKOT06001ARTransaction.execute logs pricingRuleRequest and sends it to ABKOR001.executePostMassivePricingRules. In ABKOR001Impl.executePostMassivePricingRules, validateMassivePricingRuleRequest rejects a null request or null details list, requires at least two ACT details, rejects duplicated ACT ids, and rejects any detail with null entityType or id. For each generated rule, validatePostPricingRule calls PricingRuleValidator.validatePost to reject an endDate before startDate. 2. Decisions and branches: buildMassivePricingRules separates common details from ACT details, clones the common fields, and creates one PricingRuleDTO per ACT detail. PricingRuleDuplicateValidator.checkIfPricingRuleAlreadyExistsForPost skips duplicate checks when details are empty; otherwise it checks variable candidates by pricingRuleType V and regulated candidates only when variable payment method ids exist. executePostMassivePricingRules continues only when every generated rule passes validation, then obtains user, customAttributeId, batchId, and customAttributeAuditId. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: ABKOT06001ARTransaction.execute obtains ABKOR001 and calls executePostMassivePricingRules. ABKOR001Impl.executePostMassivePricingRules uses PricingRuleDuplicateValidator.checkIfPricingRuleAlreadyExistsForPost to compare sorted details and candidate fees, PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues to resolve each detail value, PricingRuleRepository.insertAudit and insertMassiveCustomAttribute to create the massive-load custom attribute, and persistNewPricingRule to obtain sequence ids, insert the pricing rule row through PricingRuleMapper.mapToInsert, and insert each detail row. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: validateMassivePricingRuleRequest throws ABKO10010420 when pricingRuleDTO is null, details are null, or fewer than two ACT details are present; ABKO10010421 when an ACT detail id is null or repeated; and ABKO10010422 when any detail, entityType, or id is null. PricingRuleValidator.validatePost throws ABKO10000404 when endDate is before startDate. PostPricingRuleDuplicateValidator.handleVariableExactMatch throws ABKO10010401 when candidate details match exactly and the candidate fee matches, or ABKO10010402 when candidate details match exactly but the fee differs. UtilPrDuplicateValidation.throwPaymentMethodOverlap throws ABKO10010415 when non-payment-method details match and at least one payment method overlaps. PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues throws ABKO10010004 when no lookup query exists for entityType, when the resolved value is blank, or when the detail id does not exist. PricingRuleRepository.insertMassiveCustomAttribute throws ABKO00000010 when the massive custom attribute insert returns 0. executePostMassivePricingRules catches PricingRuleException, adds advice with the exception code and description, and returns an empty list; after setPricingrulesresponse, assignSeverityError sets Severity.EWR when adviceList is not empty. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: On success, each generated rule keeps the copied common fields, one ACT detail, and an added DetailsDTO(customAttributeId, EntityTypeEnum.CUS, "MASIVA"). persistNewPricingRule assigns the generated pricing rule id and PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues populates each copied detail value before persistence. ABKOT06001ARTransaction.execute always calls setPricingrulesresponse with the returned list, which can be the created pricing rules or an empty list after a PricingRuleException.
